data.name: Msg_Android10StorageSetup
data.value:
This device runs Android 10, but the app does not have direct access to shared storage yet, so opening and saving files will not work.
Android 10 needs one extra step for that (no app data is lost):
1. Download and install the small "storage setup" APK. It carries the same version as this app, so it can be installed straight on top of it (do NOT uninstall anything): {0} 2. Open "QiuUTMTv5 Storage Setup" and allow the storage permission it asks for. 3. Install this app's normal APK again, straight on top - do NOT uninstall anything in between. 4. Start this app again.
The setup APK only exists to switch Android 10 back to the legacy storage model; installing this app again replaces it.
